Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this game! The ODI series is done and Australia see their winning streak come to an end at 26 and that too against the team this streak first started. We now move on to a one-off Day and Night Test with the multi-format series nicely poised at 4-2 in favour of Australia Women. That match will begin from 30th September at 4.00 pm local (6.00 am GMT). But you know the drill, don't you? The build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, goodbye and ta-da!

The India Women captain, Mithali Raj says, that they were confident today and are very happy that they are the ones to end the streak of the Aussies. She adds that the middle order made valuable contributions and mentions a few names and also acknowledges Sneh Rana's cameo to be a very important one. Also adds that they played well in the second match and were a bit unlucky and is happy that they got to chase in this match, which helped them but says that they will look to be confident while posting scores in the future as well.

Meg Lanning, the Aussie skipper says, that they had their chances but could not take it. Says full credit to India as they came out with positive intent with the bat and bowled well as well. Mentions that they deserved the win. Tels that they didn't get the win but there were a lot of positives from the match. Informs that Sophie is a tough character and was brave to bowl those last few overs.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH, Jhulan Goswami says, that they were just trying to make it till the end and finish the game. Mentions that they lost their last match with a narrow margin so her plan was to bowl on good lengths and execute it well. Tells that she knew spinners will come into play as well. Adds that as a senior player, her role was to take positives and give her best in the field. Informs that there are a lot of aches in her body and needs time to recover but they are looking forward to the pink-ball Test match.
...THE PRESENTATION...

Right then, Meg Lanning opted to bat first and a solid show from the middle order saw them post a par score of 264 runs in the end. India Women came out quick off the blocks and the top-order clicked but it was really the lower order that got them over the line and they have won an absolute nail-bitter. Don't go anywhere as the presentation ceremony is up next..

The Australian Women snatched victory last time on and that is a result of their character, which they showed once again today. But it was not to happen today. After Mandhana’s wicket, their bowlers found it difficult to create chances but the fielding was top-notch and they didn’t give away cheap runs. Sophie Molineux and the debutant, Stella Campbell then came back on and got rid of the two set batters. This was the turning point as they knocked off the skipper soon after and left India Women staring at defeat. Sophie Molineux played through pain and even stepped up for the final over. With just 4 to defend she wasn't able to deliver but it was always going to be a bit too much. Australia Women will be disappointed with crucial catches they dropped in the final overs, which led to this shock defeat.

India Women lost their talisman, Smriti Mandhana after a brisk start. After the early setback, Shafali Verma and Yastika Bhatia took it upon themselves to steer the innings in the right direction. The pair put on a 101-run stand before Verma got dismissed. Verma looked twitchy as she made an uncharacteristic half-century but Bhatia played some shots that had a bit of flair. When Bhatia got dismissed, the rest followed suit. Then Deepti Sharma came in and held the innings together but in the end it was the contribution from Sneh Rana and Jhulan Goswami that made the difference as India Women chased down their highest ever total in ODIs.
India Women have snatched victory off Australia Women’s hands in the end. Celebrations in the Indian camp and Australia Women have seen their streak come to an end after 26 wins.

Length ball, outside off, the ball stays quite low. Shafali Verma looks to defend but the ball sneaks under her bat.
Short of a length, on off. Shafali Verma plays a short-arm jab to mid on.
Floated it up on off stump. Bhatia defends it on the off side.
Flatter delivery, on middle and leg. Bhatia works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off and played towards mid off.
FOUR! Nicely flighted, on off and turning away. Yastika Bhatia lifts it over mid off with ease and finds the boundary.
A touch short and wide, cut away to point. A slight fumble but no run taken.
Tossed up delivery, Bhatia comes down the track and inside-edges it back onto the pads.
Length again, on middle. Verma defends it with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, Verma bunts it onto the leg side.
Length ball, outisde off and tapped to cover-point.
WIDE! This one is sliding down the leg side. Verma looks to flick but misses and a wide is called.
On a good length around off, tapped to point.
WIDE! Campbell bangs one in around off stump and it's a bit too high. Verma ducks under it and a wide is signalled.
Back of a length and around leg stump. Bhatia pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Verma dabs it down towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Flatter delivery again and on off stump. Bhatia plays it towards covers off the back foot. Just the single off the over.
Flatter one, darted in at middle stump. Bhatia keeps it out on the off side.
Dragged down on off and Verma pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
It's short in length again and Verma defends it off the back foot.
Slower and shorter in length, around off. Verma hops back and works it to square leg.
On middle and nudged to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on middle and tucked away to mid-wicket.
Short ball, on leg stump. Yastika Bhatia pulls it awkwardly to the right of deep square and gets a couple of runs.
WIDE! Full and wide, outside the tramline. Wide called.
Good-length ball, on off and angling away. Bhatia looks to punch it off the back foot but gets beaten.
On middle and leg, Verma whips it through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Back of a length and around off. Verma keeps it down to backward point.
Length ball, outside off and Verma crunches it to cover-point.
The debutant, Stella Campbell is brought into the attack.
Flatter one, around off and this is tapped to point.
Flighted ball, on off. Bhatia defends it on the off side.
Tossed up, around off. Verma works it through square leg for a single.
Yastika Bhatia walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is an exceptional catch from Annabel Sutherland. Smriti Mandhana decides to be aggresive and dances down the track to lift the flighted ball over extra cover. Mandhana doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and skies it high but Sutherland runs back and dives to take this one. Ashleigh Gardner draws first blood and Mandhana has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter one, outisde off and played towards cover.
FOUR! Edged and just past the keeper. Shorter ball, around off. Mandhana rocks back looking to play it on the off side but edges it past the keeper and the ball races into the fence.
Ashleigh Gardner comes in to replace Ellyse Perry.
Short and on off, blocked out. A maiden for Sophie Molineux.
Flighted ball, on middle. Shafali Verma chips it back to the bowler. Sophie Molineux dives to her right to grab the catch but the ball doesn't stick. A tough chance there.
Drifting on the pads, Shafali Verma blocks it out.
Flighted ball, outside off. Shafali Verma pushes it to point.
Full and on leg, Shafali Verma looks to heave it on the leg side. The ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
Loopy ball on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Here comes the first bowling change. Sophie Molineux is into the attack.
Good-length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana lets it sail through. 11 runs from the over.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched to cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and on leg, Smriti Mandhana tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side. Wide given.
Full and outside off, left alone.
FIVE WIDES! Perry continues to struggle with her lines. Another wayward delivery down the leg side. Beats everyone to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs for India Women.
On a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and cuts it to point.
WIDE! Full but down the leg side. Wided.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Short of a length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana pulls it off the inner half of her bat towards deep square leg for one.

FOUR! Fuller in length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana creams it through covers. Ellyse Perry gives it a chase and flicks the ball back inside the ropes but made contact with the ropes at the same moment. A boundary. Good effort from her though.
Full and outside off, Verma slices it over backward point for a single.
Pitches it up, on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off for a single.
Good-length ball on off, tapped to cover-point.
Full and on middle, Mandhana drives it to mid on.
Outside off, pushed to covers. Just a single from it.
Full and on off, Verma jams it out onto the pitch.
Shortish ball, on off. Shafali Verma pushes it to cover.
On the pads, Smriti Mandhana flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, Mandhana stays solid in her defense.
Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Shafali Verma lifts it over covers for a couple of runs.
On off, Verma taps it to point.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma slashes it straight to covers.
On a length on middle, defended out to mid off.
Length ball, on off. Verma blocks it towards covers.
Length ball on middle, pushed to mid on.
Full and on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it beautifully through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
WIDE! Spilled way down the leg side again. Wided..
Length ball, on middle and leg, Verma tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
A quick bumper, outside off. Verma sways her head away from it.
Full and wide, driven straight to cover.
Full and swinging onto the pads. Smriti Mandhana flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Nicely bowled on that fith stump line. Mandhana looks to drive on the up but gets beaten.
WIDE! Down the leg side again from Perry. Wided.
Good-length ball, outside off. Verma looks to cut but misses.
On the pads and Mandhana flicks it to fine leg for another one.
Back of a length this time and Verma taps it past backward point for a single.
Around off and driven to the cover region by Verma.
Length ball, on the pads and tucked away onto the leg side for a run.
Length ball, outside off and left alone.
Good-length ball, outside off and whizzes past the bat of Shafali Verma. 15 runs of the over, a good one for India Women.
Pitched up, on off and pushed to mid off. Smriti Mandhana looks for the single but Verma sends her back and the fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Mandhana is back in time and survives.
FOUR! Streaky boundary for Shafali Verma but she won't mind. Short and wide, Verma thrashes at it and gets a bottom edge and the ball goes in between the keeper and first slip for another boundary.
WIDE! Length again and way outside off and swinging further away. Wided.

FOUR BYES! The ball is doing a bit too much at the moment. Pitched up outside off and this one swings a mile back in. Verma gets beaten on the inside line and Healy can't stop it. The ball goes behind into the fence for four byes.
Length ball, around off, Verma looks to drive but misses.
On the pads and turned to deep square leg for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Ellyse Perry is struggling a bit with the swing and bowls this one way down the leg side. Alyssa Healy can't reach it and the ball races into the fine leg fence.
Full and wide, shaping away. Verma caresses it through covers for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Good-length ball, angling down the leg side. Left alone and wide signalled.
Back of a length, around off. Verma hops back and dabs it down to backward point.
Length ball, on off and tapped to cover-point.
FOUR! Lovely timing from Shafali Verma. On middle and leg and Verma whips it uppishly through mid-wicket and into the fence the ball goes. Verma is up and running.
WIDE! This one is spilled down the leg side. Wided.
Length ball on the stumps and Verma defends it out.
On the pads and Smriti Mandhana gets off the mark straightaway with a flick through mid-wicket.
Tahlia McGrath to bowl from the opposite end.
Short and wide, Verma chases after it but misses the cut. Just the wide off the first over.
Length ball, on off. Verma crunches it to covers.
WIDE! Length ball, pushed wider and left alone. Wide called.
Full and wide outside off. Left alone by Shafali Verma.
On off and blocked out by Verma.
Length again and around off, tapped to cover-point.
Perry starts off with a lovely outswinger, outside off. Verma leaves it alone.
